eligible_input: Only admitted explicit RW CC0 relations with valid PMIDs on both endpoints. DOI-only relations remain CANNOT_CHECK for this bounded batched reducer; they are not negative or excluded from the RW metadata theorem.
failure_rule: Provider/parser/schema/rights ambiguity or any forbidden-field access fails closed and is preserved.

pmc_oa_exact_verification.nonmatch: CANNOT_CHECK, not a negative scientific outcome
pmc_oa_exact_verification.normalization: uppercase; normalize underscores/hyphens to single spaces only for BY tokenization; accept exactly CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA optionally followed by a numeric version token; reject ND, NC, custom, missing or unparsed

pre_freeze_disclosure.one_hidden_allowlisted PMID was used to: No identifier, title, abstract, action, row text, or protected outcome was printed or persisted. The pilot returned one resolution and a CC BY license.

sealed_action_aggregation: Query membership identifiers exist only in process memory, are aggregated over exact-rights-pass relations/families, and are then destroyed. No identifier-to-type mapping, action column, or protected terminal is written. Zero or multiple bands are CANNOT_CHECK_OTHER_OR_AMBIGUOUS.
search_allowlist_clause: OPEN_ACCESS:Y AND IN_PMC:Y AND (LICENSE:"cc0" OR LICENSE:"cc by" OR LICENSE:"cc by-sa") AND NOT (LICENSE:"cc by-nd" OR LICENSE:"cc by-nc" OR LICENSE:"cc by-nc-nd" OR LICENSE:"cc by-nc-sa")
search_interpretation: A hit is an official Europe PMC search-index candidate for exact article-specific rights verification. It is not itself final content-rights admission. Absence is CANNOT_CHECK_EPMC_SEARCH_ALLOWLIST_MATCH, never incompatible rights.
success_boundary: Nonzero exact-rights-pass relations/families and nonzero source-native aggregate type cells establish only panel-construction feasibility on the pinned public metadata universe. They do not establish terminal gold, responsibility, anti-leak views, donors, model effect, transport or external authority.
typed_cell_measures: unique source families containing at least one pass relation
wave_rule: int(sha256(canonical family key)[0:16],16) mod 2: 0 PRIMARY, 1 REPLICATION; no top-up
